  "cells": [
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# %% [markdown]\n",
        "# # kNN na prática (Íris)\n",
        "# - Normalização dos dados\n",
        "# - Busca do melhor k (GridSearch + Cross-Validation)\n",
        "# - Avaliação no conjunto de teste\n",
        "# - Gráficos: Acurácia vs k e Matriz de Confusão\n",
        "\n",
        "# %%\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import load_iris\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, ConfusionMatrixDisplay\n",
        "\n",
        "# Carrega o dataset (4 features, 3 classes)\n",
        "data = load_iris()\n",
        "X = data.data\n",
        "y = data.target\n",
        "class_names = data.target_names\n",
        "\n",
        "# Split treino/teste (estratificado para manter proporções de classe)\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Formas:\", X_train.shape, X_test.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "szl3aNdTuT7s",
        "outputId": "8f657268-3e8c-47c9-f6ff-01afcd0f1b69"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Formas: (112, 4) (38, 4)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# %%\n",
        "# Pipeline: StandardScaler (normaliza) -> KNN\n",
        "pipe = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"scaler\", StandardScaler()),\n",
        "    (\"knn\", KNeighborsClassifier())\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Grade de hiperparâmetros: k de 1 a 30, e peso uniforme vs. por distância\n",
        "param_grid = {\n",
        "    \"knn__n_neighbors\": list(range(1, 31)),\n",
        "    \"knn__weights\": [\"uniform\", \"distance\"],\n",
        "    \"knn__p\": [1, 2]  # Manhattan (1) e Euclidiana (2)\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# GridSearch com 5-fold CV\n",
        "grid = GridSearchCV(\n",
        "    estimator=pipe,\n",
        "    param_grid=param_grid,\n",
        "    scoring=\"accuracy\",\n",
        "    cv=5,\n",
        "    n_jobs=-1,\n",
        "    return_train_score=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "grid.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Melhores parâmetros:\", grid.best_params_)\n",
        "print(\"Acurácia média (CV) do melhor:\", grid.best_score_)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "GXLrqxbXusz2",
        "outputId": "4fc4ed65-d3f0-4fc2-cfb9-4be0b4f5005d"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Melhores parâmetros: {'knn__n_neighbors': 16, 'knn__p': 1, 'knn__weights': 'uniform'}\n",
            "Acurácia média (CV) do melhor: 0.9644268774703558\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# %%\n",
        "best_model = grid.best_estimator_\n",
        "y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "acc_test = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "print(f\"Acurácia no teste: {acc_test:.4f}\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Relatório de classificação:\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred, target_names=class_names))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "JyWikgZPu0Ie",
        "outputId": "b71d6833-18db-4374-ccd4-c01f8adbdacb"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Acurácia no teste: 0.9474\n",
            "\n",
            "Relatório de classificação:\n",
            "              precision    recall  f1-score   support\n",
            "\n",
            "      setosa       1.00      1.00      1.00        12\n",
            "  versicolor       0.92      0.92      0.92        13\n",
            "   virginica       0.92      0.92      0.92        13\n",
            "\n",
            "    accuracy                           0.95        38\n",
            "   macro avg       0.95      0.95      0.95        38\n",
            "weighted avg       0.95      0.95      0.95        38\n",
            "\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# %%\n",
        "# Extrai resultados do GridSearch para plotar curva de validação vs k\n",
        "results = grid.cv_results_\n",
        "ks = np.array([p[\"knn__n_neighbors\"] for p in results[\"params\"]])\n",
        "weights = np.array([p[\"knn__weights\"] for p in results[\"params\"]])\n",
        "p_norm = np.array([p[\"knn__p\"] for p in results[\"params\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Vamos filtrar por combinação de 'weights' e 'p' que gerou a melhor média\n",
        "best_w = grid.best_params_[\"knn__weights\"]\n",
        "best_p = grid.best_params_[\"knn__p\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "mask = (weights == best_w) & (p_norm == best_p)\n",
        "ks_sel = ks[mask]\n",
        "acc_mean = results[\"mean_test_score\"][mask]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ordena por k\n",
        "order = np.argsort(ks_sel)\n",
        "ks_sel = ks_sel[order]\n",
        "acc_mean = acc_mean[order]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
        "plt.plot(ks_sel, acc_mean, marker=\"o\")\n",
        "plt.title(f\"Acurácia CV vs k (weights={best_w}, p={best_p})\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"k (n_neighbors)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Acurácia (validação cruzada)\")\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 251
        },

      "execution_count": null,

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# %%\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(\n",
        "    y_test, y_pred, display_labels=class_names, cmap=\"Blues\", colorbar=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Matriz de Confusão (Teste)\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
